minimal_changes.spec: Add driver-owned fail_stop_denial(event) with fixed exit code 78. Set sticky denied state/count before other recording; construct only bounded primitive metadata (event name, PID/thread ID, monotonic timestamp, current mode). First denial creates fixed run_root/audit-denied.json using O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY, mode0600; never replace an existing first-denial marker. Write bounded JSON without product getters, locks, args dumps or arbitrary repr. Emit existing denial log best effort. Wrap all persistence in try/finally with unconditional os._exit(78), even on serialization/open/write/log failure. If a competing denial already created marker, retain it and still exit. Do not rely on raising any Python Exception/BaseException for termination; original denied OS operation must never be reached.
minimal_changes.rationale: os._exit cannot be swallowed by product broad except and ends the entire owned child even if denial came from a heartbeat/dependency thread. It skips child/native finally on this infrastructure stop; that fact is recorded and never claimed as native close evidence. OS teardown releases descriptors; parent owns descendant cleanup and preservation.

minimal_changes.spec: Add require_no_denial checks after imports, before repository/worker setup completion and READY publication, at top of each mode before MODE_STARTED/job creation, immediately before poll_once, immediately after poll return before get_job/next-mode work, and before successful child outcome. Sticky flag or marker existence must enter the same fail-stop path; no additional poll/job/import/test. No monitor calls harness.close. Guards are defensive; unconditional denial-path exit is the noncatchable stop guarantee.

Assert marker absent before the only child launch; inspect marker existence first in every existing <=20ms supervisor loop iteration, before READY/cap logic. Marker existence, including partial/unreadable JSON, sets reason AUDIT_DENIAL and immediately enters existing owned TERM/KILL/reap cleanup. Never wait for marker to become parseable or a product boundary. No new process, timer budget, or sandbox escalation. Existing child natural exit is also checked afterward for marker and reserved code 78.

After cleanup, any marker presence OR child exit code 78 OR denied log row forces state INFRA_BLOCKED_AUDIT_DENIAL and causal_verdict BLOCKED_BY_DIAGNOSTIC_POLICY. Marker parse/write errors remain fail closed with raw bytes retained. Denial takes precedence over mode-cap, natural exit or apparent native success. Report event/phase if available, marker_parse_error if applicable, operation_executed=false when audit hook rejected it, native_cleanup_skipped_on_fail_stop=true for forced child exit, and observed poll entries separately from allowed quota. If no marker due persistence error but code78, do not invent event detail. Final process return must be nonzero for any denial, even if cleanup succeeds. Do not claim no denied events based solely on log absence; consult all three sources.

For denial-free execution preserve existing exact input, native worker/locks/runner, mode order, selected profile/stack observation, 5/15/35/65 samples, all original caps, cleanup ownership and output semantics. Do not amend product, broaden network/executable allowlist or add standalone denial/lock smoke probes.
